summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: @onereach/si-alert 0.4.13 is advertised as a Vue.js input component but ships a preinstall dropper. package.json's scripts.preinstall runs node setup.mjs, which is itself hex-identifier obfuscated. setup.mjs downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unzips it, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs the Bun binary against a sibling file math_init.js in the package directory. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, hex-name obfuscated bundle with a rotated string/int array; it is not referenced by package.json's files or module fields and exists solely to be run by the freshly-installed Bun binary at install time. Using an alternate JavaScript runtime specifically evades Node-based inspection and pipeline instrumentation, and obfuscation of both the lifecycle script and the payload has no legitimate purpose for a UI input component. The behavior fires automatically on npm install via the preinstall lifecycle hook, executing attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
